serviceCards.title: Stucco Repair & Crack Patching
serviceCards.desc: Hairline cracks, chips, bulges and gaps around windows and doors, patched to suit the system on your wall. The contractor who sees the wall sets the price, and the cost guide shows what Calgary firms publish.

serviceCards.title: Parging Recoats
serviceCards.desc: Cosmetic recoating of the parging at the base of a wall when it is cracking or flaking. Foundation crack repair, waterproofing and structural work are not offered through this page.

serviceCards.title: Hail & Woodpecker Damage
serviceCards.desc: A written repair estimate for hail damage that you can give to your insurer, and patching of northern flicker holes once nesting is over. Your policy and your insurer decide what is covered; this site does not handle claims.

serviceCards.title: Re-Stucco & Recoating
serviceCards.desc: For walls that are tired, patchy or damaged across a wide area, a contractor can explain whether a repair, a recoat or a full re-stucco fits. Whole-house prices vary widely by size and system, so the quote follows the site survey.

whyUs.title: The contractor quotes you directly

whyUs.title: A written estimate you can compare
whyUs.desc: Alberta.ca advises insisting on a written contract and getting written estimates from more than one business. The introduction is no-obligation, so you can compare before you decide.

whyUs.title: Clear about what this site is
whyUs.desc: It is an advertising service paid by contractors. It holds no licence, insurance or warranty, so check the contractor yourself: ask about their Calgary business licence (311 can confirm it) and their WCB coverage.

whyUs.title: Prices named to their source
whyUs.desc: Every price on this site is attributed to the firm that published it, with a note on whether GST is included. Where no reliable Calgary figure exists, the page says the contractor quotes it after seeing the wall.

processSteps.title: Enquiry and technical discussion
processSteps.desc: Call or send the form and describe what you see: hail marks, a flicker hole, a crack, a bulge or crumbling parging. Photos help. If it is hail damage, contact your home insurance provider before any repair work, as the City of Calgary advises.

processSteps.title: Site survey and scope
processSteps.desc: The contractor looks at the wall, works out whether it is cement stucco or EIFS and checks for signs of moisture. One Calgary firm notes that nobody can tell the full extent of water damage until the wall is opened up, so scope can change.

processSteps.title: Written proposal, then the work
processSteps.desc: You get a written proposal to compare and can accept it or not. Timing follows the weather: one Calgary firm puts the stucco season at April through October, and repairs outside it need heated hoarding.

aboutBlurb:
Sandstone Stucco Co is an advertising service paid by independent Calgary stucco contractors. It does no stucco work, holds no licence, insurance or warranty, and takes no money for work. The contractor who quotes your job contracts with you directly.

Most enquiries fall into one of a few situations: a wall marked by hail, a flicker hole, cracks around windows, crumbling parging, or a finish that looks tired. Start with stucco repair in Calgary, then read about hail and woodpecker damage, parging or re-stucco. The stucco repair cost guide lists what Calgary firms publish, firm by firm.
areaBlurb: Independent contractors take enquiries across northeast Calgary, northwest Calgary, southwest Calgary and southeast Calgary, as well as Airdrie and Chestermere and Cochrane and Okotoks. The City of Calgary says all communities in the city are equally exposed to hail, so the choice of area page is about your neighbourhood's housing, not a hail map.
contactBlurb: Call (403) 555-0148 or send the form with your address and a few photos, and the contractor arranges a site survey to look at the wall and work out the scope. You then receive a written proposal with the price, with no obligation to accept it.

faq.q: How does stucco repair pricing and scoping work?
faq.a: The contractor sees the wall first, then writes a scope and a price, because the same crack can be a small patch or a moisture problem. Calgary firms publish very different ranges for similar jobs. For example, Calgary Parging lists small patch repairs at $550 to $1,125 before GST, while Martini Stone Masonry lists minor hairline crack repairs at $500 to $1,500 (GST not stated). Treat published figures as context, not a quote, and see the cost guide for the detail.

faq.q: How fast will someone respond, and how long does a repair take?
faq.a: This site cannot promise a response time or a start date, because each independent contractor sets its own schedule. Calgary Parging says most repairs take 1 to 3 days. Calgary Stucco and Slate says some repairs take two trips and some up to four, with up to weeks in between so each layer cures. Bigger jobs take longer, and the season limits when work can be done.

faq.q: Does Sandstone Stucco Co do the stucco work?
faq.a: No. It is an advertising service paid by independent contractors, and it holds no licence, insurance or warranty. The contractor who visits quotes and contracts with you directly. Ask that contractor about their Calgary business licence, WCB coverage and any warranty, and get the details in writing.

faq.q: I have hail damage. What should I do about my insurance?
faq.a: Contact your home insurance provider before any repair work, as the City of Calgary advises. The Insurance Bureau of Canada says hail damage is typically covered by home insurance, but check your own policy. A contractor can write a repair estimate that you may pass to your insurer. This site does not file, negotiate or manage claims.

faq.q: Can I fill or repair a woodpecker hole myself?
faq.a: Northern flickers are federally protected, so do not harm the bird or disturb a hole with eggs or chicks in it. Environment and Climate Change Canada says you may discourage a bird from returning with measures that cause it no harm, such as covering the area with wire mesh. Once nesting has ended, a contractor can patch and reinforce the hole.

faq.q: Can stucco be repaired in winter in Calgary?
faq.a: Often not well. Imasco's guide specification says to do no traditional stucco work when air and substrate temperatures are below 4 degrees C for 24 hours before, during and after application, and ADEX specifies 5 degrees C or above for 24 hours. Calgary Parging says off-season repairs need heated hoarding. In winter a contractor can still survey the wall, quote it and book the work for spring.
